{{Short description|Mathematical theorem}}
In [[mathematics]], the '''Ahlfors conjecture''', now a [[theorem]], states that the [[limit set]] of a [[finitely generated group|finitely generated]] [[Kleinian group]] is either the whole [[Riemann sphere]], or has [[measure zero]].

The [[conjecture]] was introduced by [[Lars Ahlfors]],<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ahlfors |first1=Lars V. |title=Fundamental polyhedrons and limit point sets of Kleinian groups |journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences |date=February 1966 |volume=55 |issue=2 |pages=251–254| jstor=57511 | mr=0194970 |doi=10.1073/pnas.55.2.251 |language=en |issn=0027-8424| pmid=16591331 | pmc=224131| bibcode=1966PNAS...55..251A | doi-access=free }}</ref> who [[mathematical proof|proved]] it in the case that the Kleinian group has a [[fundamental domain]] with a finite number of sides. [[Richard Canary]] proved the Ahlfors conjecture for [[topologically tame]] groups,<ref name="canary1993">{{Cite journal| doi = 10.1090/S0894-0347-1993-1166330-8| issn = 0894-0347| volume = 6| issue = 1| pages = 1–35| last = Canary| first = Richard D.| title = Ends of hyperbolic 3-manifolds| journal = Journal of the American Mathematical Society| access-date = 2025-08-22| date = 1993| url = https://www.ams.org/jams/1993-06-01/S0894-0347-1993-1166330-8/ | mr=1166330| jstor=2152793}}</ref> by showing that a topologically tame Kleinian group is geometrically tame, so the Ahlfors conjecture follows from Marden's [[tameness conjecture]] that [[hyperbolic 3-manifold]]s with finitely generated fundamental groups are topologically tame ([[homeomorphic]] to the interior of compact {{nowrap|3-manifolds}}). This latter conjecture was proved, independently, by [[Ian Agol]]<ref>{{cite arXiv | last = Agol| first = Ian| title = Tameness of hyperbolic 3-manifolds | date = 2004| eprint=math/0405568 }}</ref> and by [[Danny Calegari]] and [[David Gabai]].<ref>{{Cite journal| doi = 10.1090/S0894-0347-05-00513-8| volume = 19| issue = 2| pages = 385–446| last1 = Calegari| first1 = Danny| last2 = Gabai| first2 = David| title = Shrinkwrapping and the taming of hyperbolic 3-manifolds| journal = Journal of the American Mathematical Society| access-date = 2025-08-22| date = 2006-04-01| url = https://www.ams.org/jams/2006-19-02/S0894-0347-05-00513-8/| mr=2188131  | issn=0894-0347|arxiv=math/0407161 | s2cid=1053364}}</ref>

Canary also showed that in the case when the limit set is the whole sphere, the action of the Kleinian group on the limit set is ergodic.<ref name="canary1993" />
